headline: Approval of Dawn Savo as Director of Finance, with a budget amendment and employment agreement.
summary: The meeting will consider approving Dawn Savo as Director of Finance. The approval includes a budget amendment and an employment agreement.
items: Vote to approve the "Order Providing for the Approval of Dawn Savo as the Director of Finance, including Budget Amendment and Employment Agreement," as approved by the Committee of the Whole on October 28, 2026
location: Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518

A HYBRID SPECIAL MEETING OF LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL WILL BE CONDUCTED: 
IN-PERSON LOCATION: At Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518 
VIRTUALLY: https://zoom.us/j/96032210583 - ID: 960-3221-0583 - Phone (646) 558-8656 
Click for an itemized agenda with supporting documentation: https://hamdenct.portal.civicclerk.com/  
Live comments for this meeting agenda can be heard by joining the meeting in-person or via Zoom. Written 
comments must be sent to LCpublicinput@hamden.com by 3:00 PM on the date of this agenda. 
To participate in public input live or via Zoom — Raise your hand to speak when the public input session is opened. 
You will be called upon in the order that your hand is raised. Once called, you have 3 minutes to speak. You will 
return to the audience at the completion of 3 minutes. 
 
 
1. Call to Order/Taking of the Roll  
2. Pledge of Allegiance and Moment of Silence  
3. Public Comment Session  
4. Special Meeting Agenda  
 
(a) Vote of the Legislative Council to Approve the “Order Providing for the 
Approval of Dawn Savo as the Director of Finance, including Budget 
Amendment and Employment Agreement”, as approved by the Committee 
of the Whole on October 28, 20261 
  
5. Executive Session, if necessary 
6. Adjournment
